verdict.rationale: TruffleHog offers a self-hosted deployment option ("Choose hosted (managed by Truffle Security) or self-hosted (running in your environment)"), which lets users keep all scan data within their own infrastructure/region, giving indirect control over data residency. However, there is no explicit region-selection feature or documented data-residency guarantees for the hosted/enterprise offering. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for the hosted SaaS tier, compliance documentation (e.g., data localization certifications), and any mention of choosing storage location for the managed service.
